ValidationErrorResponse.description:
Response schema for a request that failed validation (422 ``validation-error``).

Extends ProblemDetail with field-level error information.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this particular occurrence of the problem.
detail.title: Detail

errors.description: Field-level validation failures, each naming the offending field (a dotted path), the reason, and the failure's type, or null when absent.

example.message: String should have at least 1 character

errors.title: Errors

instance.description: URI reference for this specific occurrence, usually the request path, or null when not set.
instance.title: Instance

status.description: The HTTP status code of the response.
status.title: Status

title.description: Short human-readable summary of the problem category.
title.title: Title

traceId.description: Correlation identifier for this request; equals the X-Request-ID response header. Quote it to support to find the request's trace and logs.
traceId.title: Traceid

type.description: Always /errors/validation-error; switch on this rather than on the detail prose.
type.title: Type

ValidationErrorResponse.title: ValidationErrorResponse

RunAttemptToken.description: The token signed for one attempt of a service run, which the host agent hands to the runner in that attempt's guest, sent as `Authorization: Bearer mush_run_<kid>.<attempt>.<fencing>.<expiry>.<sig>`. It speaks only for its attempt, only while that attempt is its run's current live one, and never past the attempt's deadline.

RunnerApiKey.description: Organization API key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer mush_{public_id}.{secret}` — a 8-character Base62 public id and a 43-character Base62 secret. Bound to the AGENT audience: the key a Musher CLI runner authenticates with.
